title: Convergence for linear quadratic potential mean field games
summary: This paper studies the limits of empirical means of open-loop Nash equilibria of linear-quadratic stochastic differential games as the number of players goes to infinity, when the corresponding mean field game is of potential type and may have multiple equilibria. Via weak compactness arguments, the limit points are characterized as optimal trajectories of the related deterministic control problem, thus ruling out some of the mean field equilibria.
